summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing over $20 million in orders from a leading global satellite operator for SkyEdge services and systems. No deal terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing reflects routine customer contract awards, not a special situation. Deliveries are expected within 24 months. No risk-arb angle or structural event; this is ordinary operational news.
